evidence: The ALD reactant timing sequence was t1-t2-t3-t4, where t1 is the exposure time for Mg(CpEt) 2, t2 is the purge following the Mg(CpEt)2 exposure, t3 is the H2O exposure, and t4 is the purge following the H 2O exposure. During the MgO ALD on silicon wafers, the timing sequence was 1 -45-1-45.
